name: The Riviera Maya EDITION at Kanai
positioning: Beachfront EDITION resort in Kanai on the Riviera Maya, opened in 2024, set in a nature reserve with a design by Ian Schrager
best_for: Travelers who want a beach resort set in a nature reserve
Guests who like private plunge pools and a cenote-inspired spa

facts.text: The hotel is sited on a 620-acre nature reserve with two miles of white-sand beaches.
The rooms reflect the design of Ian Schrager.
Some rooms have private terraces with plunge pools.
The Sky Villa is the largest penthouse in North America.
Ki'is is a restaurant built around simplicity, using ingredients from the surrounding seas and the Mexican vegetable pantry.
SO'OL Beach Club serves simple cooking with a Mexican touch and a focus on freshness.
The Spa has cenote-inspired architecture and a journey of hydrotherapy pools, a private outdoor pool and a Turkish hammam.
The central pool is inspired by the region's mangroves and cenotes.
The pool has floating cabanas and a gently sloping sun shelf with loungers.
The beach has a private deck with oceanfront cabanas.
Lobby Bar serves agave distillates, regional wines and cocktails in a lobby with three-story windows.

highlights.text: The Sky Villa is the largest penthouse in North America.
The hotel is sited on a 620-acre nature reserve with two miles of white-sand beaches.
The Spa has cenote-inspired architecture and a journey of hydrotherapy pools, a private outdoor pool and a Turkish hammam.
The pool has floating cabanas and a gently sloping sun shelf with loungers.
The hotel employs two property biologists who lead environmental protection, including a sea turtle conservation program.

considerations.text: SO'OL Beach Club has DJ music from sunset into the night.
Private plunge pools are a feature of the suites, not of every room.
